diagnosis.primaryIssue: The strong example uses the stable slug as the visible product title.
diagnosis.contractConflict: The skill criticizes directory-like titles while its own strong example presents one.
diagnosis.minimumFix: Use the catalog displayName as the visible title and show the slug separately as routing metadata.

recommendedCopy.summary: Audit how your ClawHub skill reads before publishing. 找出标题、摘要、目标用户和差异化中最伤转化的一处。
recommendedCopy.firstParagraph: 能发布不等于有人想安装。Skill Positioning Audit 会在上架前检查标题、摘要、目标用户和差异化，指出当前最像模板、最该先改的一处。

differentiation.job: Diagnose storefront positioning rather than publish syntax.
differentiation.targetUser: Authors with a publishable ClawHub skill whose storefront still feels generic.
differentiation.memorableRule: Can publish is not the same as worth installing.
